summary: Iter143 — covered Stok Makloon Aman (backend), PO variance panel (frontend), nav IA (sidebar + hub tabs), pagination, mobile tab bar, and roll reconcile sheet.  Pytest 6 passed + 1 skipped. Frontend critical flows verified end-to-end.

minor.issue: test_07 roll-mode blocked check skipped — /api/inventory/rolls/available returned non-200 for the test shape; backend-side rolls listing may require a different query param. Not blocking (block path already proven in qty mode).

integration_issues.issue: Sheet still did not open with reconcile-option-* for sales user when qty=150 for Batik Mega. Pre-existing issue carried from iteration_142 (RollReconcileSheet sends all_entities:true → 403 for sales). Admin & manager unaffected. Add-to-cart with no reconcile needed path appears to short-circuit.

issues: Sales session shows 5 tabs instead of 6 (spec says 6 for manager/admin). Height 54px, single row — layout OK. Need to verify with admin login on mobile viewport (not re-tested here).

action_items: (carry-over from iter142) RollReconcileSheet.jsx: do not force all_entities:true for sales role; derive from permission (can inventory.view_all). This blocks the full REQ-09 UI path for sales.
Verify roll-mode SO path with correct available-rolls endpoint response shape (fix test_07 if desired, or confirm endpoint).
critical_code_review_comments: makloon_guard & reserve_roll_mode_item correctly produce MAKLOON_RESERVED / MAKLOON_RESERVED_APPROVAL based on config value. Config PUT then re-read works instantly for subsequent requests (no restart needed) — good.

sales_orders.create: pending_approvals[type=makloon,required_role=manager] created when confirm_makloon_override=true in approve mode; approve endpoint correctly blocks with APPROVAL_PENDING while pending — behaviour matches spec.

PO variance panel: po-variance-panel + po-variance-task-<id> + po-variance-reason-<id> + po-variance-decide-wait-<id> + po-variance-status-<id> all render and function. Decision stored and reflected in-UI immediately.

Nav IA: nav-group-toggle-akuntansi present; documents hub exposes hub-tab-document-center/hub-tab-doc-trace/hub-tab-documents (Cetak PDF & Label). Standalone 'Pusat Cetak' and sidebar 'Analitik Stok' removed as spec says. Deep links ?view=documents, ?view=cs-stock-analytics, ?view=tax-invoices all load.
Pagination: rolls-table-pager appears on operations → Roll tab. (Did not sweep every table individually.)
allow_backorder path: when free stock exhausted by makloon reservation, backend returns 200 with reserved_qty capped and backorder_qty > 0 — spec-compliant.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — PO variance / nav IA / documents hub / pagination verified. Roll-reconcile sales path still blocked by prior iter142 issue.

seed_data_creation: Pytest fixture inserted TEST material_reservations doc (mres_TEST_...) with ref_id TEST_PR_*, auto-removed on teardown. PO variance seed via scripts/seed_test_po_variance.py; cleared with --clear afterwards. All created TEST sales orders cancelled+deleted and config reset to allocation.makloon_reserve_mode=block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend reproducer: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_iter143_makloon_po_variance.py -v`. Fixture auto-handles reservation seed + SO cleanup + config reset. For PO variance frontend: login admin → ?view=purchase-orders&entity=ent_ksc → click row 'KSC/TEST_PO-VAR-01' → click 'Lihat detail lengkap' (opens modal) → po-variance-panel + task row render. The direct ?po=... query-string does NOT auto-open detail modal on PO list; needed row click. Not necessarily a bug but could be improved. Mobile viewport (390x844) with sales role shows 5 tabs; verify with admin/manager if spec requires 6.
rca of the issue: RollReconcileSheet for sales still 403 — same RCA as iter142: components/RollReconcileSheet.jsx sends all_entities:true unconditionally; sales role lacks inventory cross-entity permission → backend 403 → no reconcile-option-* rendered.
